seo.title: Affiliate Disclosure | Dollar Bets
seo.meta_description: How Dollar Bets makes money. We may earn commissions from links. Here's exactly how that works.

body.content: Dollar Bets is funded by affiliate commissions. When you click a link to Kalshi and sign up, Dollar Bets may earn a commission. You should know that upfront.

Every link to Kalshi on Dollar Bets is an affiliate link. Kalshi tracks when you sign up through that link and credits Dollar Bets with a commission. That commission doesn't change what you pay — you're not paying extra because you came through Dollar Bets. It's just how Kalshi attributes sign-ups.

Dollar Bets doesn't cherry-pick markets based on commission. The daily scanner picks markets based on entertainment value — what's weird, funny, culturally relevant, or has an insane payout. If Kalshi paid more commission for dumb markets, we still wouldn't feature them. Our only incentive is keeping the board interesting enough that people come back.

We're independently operated. Dollar Bets is not owned by Kalshi, not controlled by Kalshi, and not obligated to feature Kalshi over any other platform. Kalshi just happens to be the best US-regulated prediction market that exists, so that's what we link to.

Transparency matters. You should know that every link has a financial incentive behind it. That's not a secret — it's just the business model. Some sites hide affiliate links or pretend they're neutral recommendations. We're not doing that. You clicked here, now you know the score.
Dollar Bets exists because prediction markets are interesting. The affiliate model just keeps the lights on while we do it.

compliance: Legal requirement. Dollar Bets may earn affiliate commissions from Kalshi sign-ups. This disclosure is made in accordance with FTC guidelines.
